Coexists with existing RF-LIFESTYLE-PROCESSED-MEAT-PREVENTION — both may fire.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for ATM heter: Prevention-persona RedFlag for ATM heterozygous carriers. Distinction from biallelic A-T phenotype is critical: heterozygotes have cancer predisposition only (no neurologic phenotype). Engine routes to enhanced breast surveillance + pancreatic surveillance for FDR-of- PDAC carriers per CAPS consortium 2022; prostate awareness for males. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BAP1 synd: Forebyggende-persona RedFlag for BAP1-syndrom familiehistorie. STUB venter på to-co-lead afmelding.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BARD1 het: Prevention-persona RedFlag for BARD1 heterozygous carriers. Engine routes to enhanced breast surveillance + ovarian symptom-driven workup. NCCN places BARD1 in moderate-elevated breast tier (annual mammography from age 40; consider MRI). Triple-negative subset signal may justify earlier or MRI-inclusive screening in family- history-stratified cohorts. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BHD/FLCN: Forebyggende-person-Flag for BHD/FLCN bekræftet bærere. Multi-organ overvågning: abdominal MRI q2-3y fra 20 alder for RCC (undgå stråling; mange BHM læsioner er hybrid oncocytic + langsom-voksende); bryst HRCT baseline + symptomdrevet (spontaous pneumothorax udløser høj opløsning billeddannelse); dermatologi q1y til hudovervågning. Nephron-sparende kirurgi (delvis nefrektomi) foretrækkes for ≤ 3cm nyrelesioner givet multifokal/bilateral sygdom mønster. STUB afventer to-co-lead afskrivning pr. CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BRIP1 het: Prevention-persona RedFlag for BRIP1 heterozygous carriers. NCCN endorses RRSO at completed childbearing or age 45-50; no population ovarian cancer screening recommended. Breast surveillance per general-population schedules unless family history independently elevates risk. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for C. sinens: Prevention-persona RedFlag for C. sinensis-driven cholangiocarcinoma prevention. Fires on any documented exposure history with confirmatory testing. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending praziquantel (if active infection) + lifelong hepatobiliary surveillance (US + CA 19-9 q12mo from age 40 in heavily-exposed cohorts). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-CHOLANGIOCARCINOMA. East-Asian endemic belt has 10-50x higher cholangiocarcinoma incidence than non-endemic Western populations. Geographic context: relevant for East-Asian diaspora, immigrants, refugees, adoptees. Companion to RF-OPISTHORCHIS-CHOLANGIO-PREVENTION (Mekong-region liver-fluke pathway, biologically similar mechanism — identical surveillance protocol).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CDH1 / HD: Forebyggende-person RedFlag for CDH1 / HDGC bekræftet luftfartsselskaber pr. GAMELC 2020 international retningslinje. Prophylactic total gastrectomy (PTG) anbefales i alderen 20-30 (interval 18-40 pr. individualiseret diskussion); endoskopisk overvågning anerkendes underordnet PTG (diffuse-type signet-ring celle foci dårligt synlig) men tilbydes til PT G-degressive luftfartsselskaber. Huntransportører: BRCA-lignende brystovervågning fra 30 år. STUB afventer to-Co-Lead aftastning pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CDKN2A-sp: Prevention-persona RedFlag for CDKN2A-specific carriers (gene-specific RF vs the broader FAMMM RF). Pancreatic surveillance per CAPS Consortium 2018/2020: alternating EUS + abdominal MRI/MRCP every 12 months from age 40 OR 10 years before earliest PDAC in family (whichever earlier). Melanoma surveillance: annual full-body skin examination + dermoscopy from age 10-12; mapping photography for multiple atypical moles. Patient should know aggressive sun protection + lifelong CDKN2A-specific cohort. STUB pending two-Co- Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CHEK2 het: Prevention-persona RedFlag for CHEK2 heterozygous carriers. Risk estimates vary substantially by variant: truncating > splice > missense. Engine routes to enhanced breast surveillance (annual mammography from age 40 + MRI consideration), modestly tightened CRC screening (colonoscopy from age 40 with q5y interval per NCCN), and prostate awareness from age 40-45 for males with c.1100delC. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CMMRD con: Prevention-persona RedFlag for CMMRD confirmed-carrier pediatric cohort. Surveillance per Care for CMMRD (C4CMMRD) consortium 2014: whole-body MRI annually from diagnosis; brain MRI q6mo from age 2; colonoscopy q6mo from age 6; upper GI endoscopy + small-bowel capsule annual from age 8; CBC + serum protein electrophoresis + abdominal US q6mo. Cascade testing of siblings + parental MMR carrier confirmation. Immunotherapy (anti-PD-1) effective in established CMMRD-related cancers (Bouffet 2016, Larkin/CheckMate series). STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for Cronkhite: Prevention-persona RedFlag for Cronkhite-Canada syndrome. risk_category set to chronic_condition (not genetic) because etiology is acquired autoimmune-like + non-Mendelian. Surveillance: colonoscopy q1-2y from diagnosis; upper endoscopy q1-2y; small-bowel capsule q2y; treat active disease with immunosuppression (prednisone taper + azathioprine maintenance) + nutritional support (protein replacement, electrolyte correction). Mortality reduced markedly with immuno- suppression treatment. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for DES in-ut: Overvågning intensiveres i forhold til den generelle befolkning (årlig bækken med omhyggelig vaginal/cervical inspektion, kolposkopi hvis unormal cytologi, mammografi ved yngre aldersgrænse pr. NCCN modificerende risiko, overveje MRI brystscreening adjunct givet dobbelt risiko). STUB afventer to- co-lead afskrivning pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for DICER1 co: Forebyggende-person RedFlag for DICER1 bekræftet-carrier cohort. Pediatrisk overvågning pr. International PPB Registry / IDSDB anbefalinger: - CT q4-6 mo fra fødslen til alderen 3, q6-12 mo til alder 8. - Abdominal US q3-6 mo, fra f.eks. til alder 8, - Thyroid US baseline ved alderen 8 + q3-5 y. - Pelvic USA i kvindelige bærere fra menarke. - Brain MRI baseline + symptomdrevet. Kirurgi kurativ for PPBS type I, når det opdages tidligt, avanceret PPb type III (fast komponent) meget aggressiv. Risikoreducerende ochorectomy er ikke godkendt til Sertoli-Leydig forebyggelse. STUB afventer to-co-lead afmelding pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for EBV-drive: Prevention-persona RedFlag for EBV-driven cancer prevention in immunocompromised hosts. Unlike HCV/HBV/H. pylori, there is no curative anti-EBV regimen; the prevention pathway is (a) reduce immunosuppression where feasible, (b) preemptive rituximab in post-transplant patients with rising EBV-DNA (per international PTLD guidelines), (c) periodic EBV-DNA monitoring. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Gating by additional immunocompromise context is deliberate — EBV seroprevalence is >90% in immunocompetent adults globally, so a RF triggered on EBV alone would fire universally and provide no clinical signal.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for FAMMM / C: Forebyggende-persona RedFlag for FAMMM / CDKN2A. STUB afventer to-Co-Lead afmelding.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HBV-assoc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HBV-associated cancer prevention. Fires on HBsAg+ OR detectable HBV-DNA in patient without HCC. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending nucleos(t)ide analog suppression (per IND-CHRONIC-HBV-PREVENTION-ANTIVIRAL) + AFP+US HCC surveillance q6mo per AASLD protocol. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchor target DIS-HCC. HBV-associated DLBCL/NHL is also documented in literature but with weaker effect-size data than the HCV-NHL link; covered via the broader NHL prevention surveillance bullet in the antiviral indication rationale. Distinct from RF-UNIVERSAL-HBV-REACTIVATION-RISK (existing) which is the treatment-time RF for HBV reactivation during anti-CD20 / chemo.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HCV + HBV: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HCV + HBV coinfection cancer prevention. Higher severity (critical) than either mono-infection RF — coinfection carries documented synergistic HCC risk AND DAA-cure-induced HBV reactivation risk that requires combination antiviral. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending concurrent DAA + nucleos(t)ide analog + intensified HCC surveillance (US + AFP q4-6mo, more frequent than the q6mo cadence for either mono-infection). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-HCC. NHL prevention (HCV-driven) continues to be a secondary benefit; tracked via prose in the combined-antiviral indication rationale. Distinct from RF-CHRONIC-HCV-NHL-PREVENTION-OPPORTUNITY and RF-CHRONIC-HBV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (individual mono-infection RFs). When coinfection trigger fires, this RF takes precedence over the two individual RFs (higher priority).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HHV-8-dri: Forebyggende-person-Flag til HHV-8-drevet malignitet forebyggelse. Brande på HHv-8 seropositivitet i HIV+, transplantation, eller anden immunkompromitteret vært uden bekræftet Kaposi sarkom / MCD / PEL. Motorruter til forebyggelsePlan anbefale immunretablering (ART for HIV+; transplant-immunosuppression rebalance) + slimhinde + oral + GI / lymfenode overvågning. STUB afventer co- Lead review. Cancer anvendelsesområde: forankret til DIS-KAPOSI. MCD og PEL er HHV-8-drevne, men endnu ikke opformeret som særskilte sygdomsenheder — dækket via pros overvågningsgrundlaget i indikationen for nu. Afskærmning fra RF-CHRONIC-HIV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (eksisterende) — dvs. HIV-as-RF; dette er HVV-8 - positivitet-as -RF (samfaktoren, der forvandler HIV-relateret immunkompromittering til Kaposi risiko specifikt).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV + HBV: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV + HBV coinfection cancer prevention. Higher severity (critical) than mono-infection HBV RF — coinfection carries documented accelerated-fibrosis + elevated HCC risk AND a hard constraint on antiviral selection (tenofovir-based ART mandatory; entecavir monotherapy contraindicated). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending tenofovir-based ART (covers both viruses simultaneously) + AASLD HCC surveillance q6mo. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-HCC. HIV-driven AIDS-defining malignancies (Kaposi sarcoma via HHV-8 reactivation, NHL, cervical) are covered separately via RF-CHRONIC-HIV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION and RF-CHRONIC-HHV8-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION. Distinct from RF-CHRONIC-HBV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION and RF-CHRONIC-HIV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (individual mono-infection RFs). When coinfection trigger fires, this RF takes precedence (higher priority) and the indication enforces tenofovir-based ART selection.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV-assoc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV-associated cancer prevention. Fires on positive HIV serology in patient without AIDS-defining or HIV-associated malignancy. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending durable ART suppression (per IND-CHRONIC-HIV-PREVENTION-ART) + cancer screening cadence (annual anal cytology in MSM/HIV+; q3-yearly cervical Pap in WLHIV; opportunistic Kaposi/oral hairy leukoplakia visual screening). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS as the canonical HIV-associated NHL. KS, cervical, anal, Hodgkin, HCC are also HIV-associated; covered via screening recommendations in the ART indication rationale rather than discrete Disease anchors (until DIS-KAPOSI etc. land in v0.2-A authoring backlog).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HPRC. STU: Forebyggende person RedFlag for HPRC. STUB afventer to-co-lead afmelding.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HPV-assoc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HPV-associated cancer prevention. Fires on persistent high-risk HPV positivity OR incomplete/absent vaccination in age-eligible individual. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending vaccination (Gardasil-9) and/or risk-group-appropriate screening cadence (cervical: USPSTF Pap+HPV co-test q5y ages 30-65; anal: HRA + cytology q1y in MSM/HIV+/post-transplant). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-CERVICAL and DIS-ANAL-SCC. Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and vulvar/vaginal/penile not yet in KB — v0.2-A authoring backlog.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HTLV-1-dr: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HTLV-1-driven ATLL prevention. Unlike HCV/HBV/H. pylori, there is no curative regimen — the intervention is surveillance + transmission prevention, not cure. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Geographic context: HTLV-1 endemic regions include Japan (southwest), Caribbean basin, parts of sub-Saharan Africa, parts of South America, Middle East. Ukraine is low-prevalence; this RF is more relevant for diaspora patients or those with travel/origin from endemic regions.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for I-131 the: Prevention-persona RedFlag for I-131 therapeutic-dose lifetime cumulative exposure. Surveillance: CBC q12mo for leukemia signal (sensitivity modest); breast surveillance per general-population USPSTF unless additional risk factors; oral + salivary symptom awareness. Highest-impact preventive intervention is hydration + lemon-juice sialagogue during I-131 administration (reduces salivary gland uptake) — retrospectively non-actionable for prior exposure. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for MASLD/NAF: Prevention-persona RedFlag for MASLD/NAFLD HCC risk. Cirrhotic MASLD meets AASLD HCC-surveillance threshold (US ± AFP q6mo). Non-cirrhotic advanced fibrosis is a gray zone — closer hepatology follow-up but not yet routine surveillance. Major actionable lever: weight loss + cardiometabolic management. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for NF1 confi: Prevention-persona RedFlag for NF1 confirmed-carrier / clinical- diagnostic-criteria-met cohort. Multi-organ surveillance: pediatric ophthalmology q6-12mo to age 8 (optic glioma); whole-body MRI for MPNST surveillance + symptom-driven biopsy of growing/painful/ neurologically-symptomatic plexiform neurofibromas; women: annual mammography from age 30, MRI from age 30-50. STUB pending two-Co- Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for O. viverr: Forebyggende-persona RedFlag for O. viverrini-drevet kolangiocarcinoma forebyggelse. Brande på enhver dokumenteret eksponering historie med bekræftende test. Motorruter til forebyggelsePlan anbefale praziquantel (hvis aktiv infektion) + livslang hepato galde overvågning (US + CA 19-9 q12mo fra 40 år i stærkt udsatte kohorter). STUB afventer co-lead gennemgang. Cancer anvendelsesområde: forankret til DIS-CHOLANGIOCARCINOMA. Nordøst Thailand har verdens højeste kolangiocarcinoma forekomst (op til 90 pr. 100K) — henførbar fraktion i endemiske regioner overstiger 50%. Geografisk sammenhæng: relevant for Mekong-region diaspora, flygtninge, rejsende og adopterede. Samspil med RF-CLONORCHIS-CHOLANGIO-PREVENTION (østasiatisk lever-fluke-vej, biologisk lignende mekanisme).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for PALB2 het: Forebyggende-person RedFlag for PALB2 heterozygote bærere. PAL B2 nærmer sig BRCA2 brystkræft penetrance og garanterer BRCA-stil overvågning med årligt bryst MRI + mammografi fra 30 år, plus pankreas overvågning (EUS eller MRI skiftende årligt fra 50 år, eller 10 år før tidligst PTC i familie) for FDR-of-PDAC bærere pr CAPS konsortium 2022. RRSO diskussion udsættes til BRCA tærskel givet lavere ovariepenetrans. STUB afventer to-co-lead afskrivning pr. CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for PCOS-anov: Forebyggende- persona RedFlag for PCOS- anovulation endometriale risiko. Skillet fra den brede reproduktive RF for klarere routing - PCOS - specifik rådgivning (progestin restaurering, metformin, vægttab) adskiller sig fra generisk reproduktiv- historie rådgivning. Symptomdrevet endometrial biopsi ved unormal blødning ≥6 måneders amenorhea pre- menopausale eller enhver post- menoopathy blødning. STUB afventer to- Co- bly tegn pr CHARTER §6.1 dev- tilstand.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for RAD51C/RA: Prevention-persona RedFlag for RAD51C/RAD51D heterozygous carriers. Approaches BRCA-level ovarian penetrance — NCCN endorses RRSO at completed childbearing or age 45-50. Breast surveillance: individualised by family history; consider annual MRI in additional- risk subset. Olaparib PARP inhibitor active in RAD51C/D-mutant established ovarian cancer (PROfound + GEN-ALL trials). STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for S. haemat: Prevention-persona RedFlag for S. haematobium-driven bladder SCC prevention. Fires on any documented exposure history with confirmatory testing. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending praziquantel (if active infection) + lifetime urinary surveillance (urinalysis q6-12mo, cytology + cystoscopy for any new hematuria). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-UROTHELIAL. S. haematobium-driven bladder cancers are predominantly SCC histology (distinct from urothelial / transitional cell carcinoma that dominates Western cohorts) — engine surfaces this distinction in the prevention rationale prose. Geographic context: Ukraine is non-endemic; this RF is relevant for patients with diaspora / refugee / travel / origin history from sub-Saharan Africa, Egypt, Sudan, Yemen, parts of South America.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for SDH-defic: Forebyggende-person-Præcision RedFlag for SDH-mangel syndrom. STUB afventer to-Co-Lead afmelding.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for active to: Forebyggende-person RedFlag til aktiv tobaksbrug. Højeste-effekt modificerbar cancer-risiko-faktor intervention. Motorruter til forebyggelsePlan anbefale struktureret stoprådgivning + farmakoterapi + LDCT lung screening, hvis USPSTF-støtte. STUB afventer to-klinisk-co-lead afmelding pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for anthracyc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for anthracycline cumulative dose ≥250 mg/m². Cardio surveillance focus (HF / cardiomyopathy); t-AML surveillance overlap covered by separate RF-IATROGENIC-TOPO2-TAML-PREVENTION. Echo q1-5y depending on risk profile (ASCO/COG-LTFU cadence). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending baseline + serial echo + BNP. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for aromatic-: Prevention-persona RedFlag for aromatic-amines → urothelial bladder cancer prevention. Fires on documented occupational exposure. DIS-UROTHELIAL anchor preferred but using DIS-HCC as fallback if not in KB on this branch. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic E: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic ETS exposure (household / workplace ≥10y). IARC Group 1 + US Surgeon General-confirmed cause of lung cancer in non-smokers. risk_category=occupational is closest enum match — schema lacks an explicit 'environmental' enum. Distinct from active-smoking RF. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending exposure elimination (cohabitant smoking cessation / workplace smoke-free policy enforcement / personal mitigation) + USPSTF screening eligibility check + symptom-triggered evaluation. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic P: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic PPI exposure ≥10y. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending (1) indication-review + de-prescription where the PPI is no longer needed (most common scenario), (2) fasting gastrin + chromogranin A in cohort with persistent acid-suppression indication, (3) EGD with body/fundus biopsies in those with elevated gastrin or symptoms; surveillance EGD q3-5y if atrophic gastritis or ECL hyperplasia documented. Anchored to DIS-GASTRIC (gastric NET and atrophic-gastritis-derived adenocarcinoma both gastric-body diseases); NET-specific outcomes carried in indication prose. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic a: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic anti-TNF biologic exposure ≥3y in pediatric / adolescent / young-adult IBD cohort. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending (1) EBV serology baseline in young adults, (2) B-symptom + lymphadenopathy awareness, (3) annual skin examination (synergistic with concomitant thiopurine + UV), (4) periodic shared-decision discussion of combination- therapy step-down where IBD activity allows (anti-TNF monotherapy has favourable cancer signal vs combination with thiopurine), (5) vaccination catch-up (HPV, HBV, influenza, pneumococcal). Severity = minor — absolute attributable risk in anti-TNF monotherapy is small; the meaningful signal is the combination- with-thiopurine HSTCL warning specifically in pediatric / young- adult cohort, addressed via combination-step-down counseling. Anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS + DIS-HSTCL. STUB pending two-Clinical- Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic i: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic inorganic arsenic exposure via drinking water >10 µg/L (WHO + US EPA MCL). IARC Group 1 carcinogen with established urothelial, lung, and non-melanoma skin cancer etiology. Anchored to DIS-UROTHELIAL per task brief; lung + skin surfaced via relevant_diseases. risk_category=occupational is closest enum match. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending water source change / filtration + intensified screening for affected organs. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic o: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic occupational outdoor UV exposure ≥10y in high-UV-index latitudes. IARC Group 1 solar UV. Distinct from broader RF-LIFESTYLE-UV-EXPOSURE-PREVENTION (which covers tanning beds + sunburn history + recreational UV). Anchored to DIS-BCC per task brief (closest skin DIS to UV-NMSC). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending photoprotection counseling + clinical skin exam cadence + patient skin self-exam education + Vitamin D balance. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic p: Forebyggende-person-RødFlag for kronisk pankreatitis → PDAC. Hereditary pankreat bærer højeste risiko (~40-50% levetid). STUB afventer to- Co-Lead afsign.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic r: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic residential PM2.5 >35 µg/m³ annual average (WHO 2021 IT-1). IARC Group 1 outdoor air pollution + PM. Population-attributable fraction modest individually but large absolute burden in high-exposure regions including industrial Ukraine + during war-related fire / debris events. risk_category=occupational is the closest enum match — schema lacks an explicit 'environmental' enum (§20 ratification pending). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending exposure reduction + USPSTF lung-cancer screening eligibility + symptom-triggered evaluation. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic ≥: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic ≥3y post-transplant immunosuppression cohort. Engine routes to PreventionPlan with long-cycle surveillance cadence appropriate to the chronic cohort (vs the acute-window EBV-DNA cadence in the new-transplant RF). Distinct from RF-IATROGENIC-TRANSPLANT-IMMUNOSUPPRESSION- PREVENTION (which covers acute / new-transplant window). Both RFs may fire simultaneously in the early-chronic window (1-3y post-transplant) — engine routes to both surveillance tracks, render layer deduplicates overlapping recommendations. Anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS as the primary lymphoma anchor (late- onset PTLD histology more DLBCL-like; DIS-PTLD as the canonical early-onset EBV-driven entity). Multiple cancer types listed in relevant_diseases reflect the broad cumulative-risk profile of the chronic cohort. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for combined: Prevention-persona RedFlag for combined HRT exposure ≥5y. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending (1) shared-decision discussion of risk-benefit (vasomotor symptoms, bone-density preservation vs breast / VTE / cardiovascular risks), (2) lowest-effective-dose + shortest-duration principle per NAMS / ACOG, (3) breast surveillance per USPSTF cadence — supplemental imaging not recommended on HRT alone (density-related supplemental imaging is a separate axis), (4) symptom-prompted endometrial workup (any abnormal bleeding → TVUS + biopsy) for women on sequential/cyclic combined or with intact uterus on any HRT, (5) annual GYN exam. Distinct from RF-IATROGENIC-TAMOXIFEN-ENDOMETRIAL-PREVENTION (different mechanism: SERM with partial endometrial agonism). STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Forebyggende-person RedFlag for kombineret lavt calcium indtag + vitamin D mangel. WCRF/AICR sandsynlighed-bevis for calc og CRC; IARC samlet signal for vitamin D status. RCT bevis for tilskud blandes ved populationsdoser — rådgivning understreger tilstrækkelig indtagelse/opløsning ikke farmakologisk dosering. Motor veje til forebyggelsePlan anbefale kostrådgivning + vitaminD opløsning + CRC screening pr. USPSTF. STUB afventer to-klinisk-Co-lead afmelding pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for cumulativ: Forebyggende-person-RadFlag for kumulativ hormonel-kontraception eksponering ≥10y, iatrogen-akse (udbredelse-som-risiko). Engine routes to PreventionPlan anbefaler HPV co-test efter plan pr. ASCCP / USPSTF, alders-passende mammografisk screening pr. USPSTF, opmærksomhed symptom historie (brystknold, unormal blødning). Alvorlighed mindre - absolut risikostigning lille, effekt på brystkræft svækkes efter stop. Forskellen fra RF-REPRODUCTIVE-OCP-LONG-TERM (afbalanceret risiko-nytte rådgivning, jf §20 reproduktiv spand). STUB venter på to-klinisk-co-lead aftegnning pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for endometri: Prevention-persona RedFlag for endometriosis-associated ovarian cancer risk. NO routine population-screening tool exists (CA-125 + TVUS not recommended for general or endometriosis screening per NCCN/USPSTF). Counseling: symptom awareness; consider risk-reducing salpingectomy at completed childbearing or at hysterectomy for benign indications; BSO reserved for those with additional risk factors. STUB pending two-Co- Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for heavy alc: Forebyggende-person RedFlag til svær alkoholbrug. Motorruter til forebyggelsePlan anbefale struktureret ophør/moderation rådgivning + farmakoterapi + passende kræft screening (sandstopendoskopi til høj risiko, brystkræft overvågning for kvinder). STUB afventer to-klinisk-co-lead afmelding pr CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for high cumu: Forebyggende-person RedFlag for høj kumulativ UV eksponering. IARC Gruppe 1 klassificering for garvesenge (2009). NCCN Melanoma + AAD retningslinjer understøtter UV-beskyttelse rådgivning + hud selveksamen + klinisk hudundersøgelse cadence. Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) — confirmed by characteristic cholangiographic findings on MRCP or ERCP (multifocal intra-/extra- hepatic biliary strictures with intervening dilatation, beaded appearance) and/or liver biopsy (concentric periductal fibrosis, onion-skin pattern). Includes PSC-IBD subgroup (very high risk for both CRC and cholangiocarcinoma) and PSC with dominant biliary stricture (additional cholangiocarcinoma risk requiring focused diagnostic workup). No current cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder cancer, or HCC diagnosis. PSC is the strongest known risk factor for cholangiocarcinoma — lifetime risk ~10-15% (vs ~0.01% in general population); annual incidence ~0.5-1.5% per year. Prodrug hydrolyzed by carboxylesterases: Prodrug hydrolyzed by carboxylesterases to active metabolite SN-38 (~100-1000× more potent than parent). SN-38 stabilizes the topoisomerase-I/DNA cleavable complex, producing single-strand DNA breaks that become lethal double-strand breaks during S-phase replication. SN-38 is glucuronidated by UGT1A1 to inactive SN-38G; patients homozygous for UGT1A1*28 (Gilbert-syndrome variant) or *6 have impaired clearance and severe neutropenia + diarrhea risk — CPIC and FDA label both recommend testing before high-dose use.
Prodrug requiring hepatic CYP3A4 / CYP2B: Prodrug requiring hepatic CYP3A4 / CYP2B6 activation to 4-hydroxy- ifosfamide, which decomposes to ifosforamide mustard — the active DNA- alkylating species producing N7-guanine inter-strand crosslinks and apoptosis in proliferating cells. Side-chain oxidation also generates acrolein (urotoxic — drives hemorrhagic cystitis, neutralized by mesna) and chloroacetaldehyde (the principal neurotoxic metabolite responsible for ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy).
Prodrug that is acid-activated in the pa: Prodrug, der er syreaktiveret i parietalcellens sekretoriske canalificulus til en sulfenamid kation, som danner en kovalent disulfidbinding med cysteinrester af H+/K+-ATPase (protonpumpe) og uigenkaldeligt hæmmer gastrisk syresekretionen. Ny pumpesyntese er nødvendig for at genvinde (≥24 timers halveringstid trods ~1 timers plasma halveringstid). Kræftforebyggende relevans: dyb mavesyre suppression er påkrævet for H. pylori antimikrobiell effekt (clarithromycin og amoxicillin kræver både nærneutral gastrisk pH for stabilitet og bakteriedrepende aktivitet) - PPI er luchpin for tredobbelt / firedobbelt H. pyloris udryddelsesregimer.

R175H is the most common TP53 missense h: R175H is the most common TP53 missense hotspot across all human cancers (~5-7% of TP53-mutant tumors per IARC TP53 Database). Structural class mutant — the R175 substitution to histidine disrupts the DNA-binding domain fold (zinc-coordination region). Beyond loss-of-function (LoF), R175H is a canonical example of mutant-p53 GAIN-OF-FUNCTION (GOF): the mutant protein acquires pro-oncogenic activities (chemoresistance via NF-kB, increased migration/invasion, metabolic reprogramming, chronic inflammation). Clinical implication: R175H+ tumors generally have worse chemo response than TP53-WT or even other TP53-mut tumors. In AML: TP53-mut (any) including R175H → very poor outcomes with intensive chemo, route to alloSCT or venetoclax-azacitidine + clinical trials. In MM: routes to quadruplet per high-risk cytogenetics composite. Emerging GOF-targeting strategies (eprenetapopt/APR-246, arsenic trioxide for structural mutants) are largely investigational; R175H specifically among the reactivatable structural mutants.
R248 is one of the six most-mutated codo: R248 is one of the six most-mutated codons in TP53 (along with R175, G245, R249, R273, R282). DNA-contact class: R248 sits in the L3 loop and makes direct base-specific contact with the DNA minor groove. Substitution to glutamine (R248Q) abolishes sequence-specific DNA binding while preserving overall fold (distinguishing it from structural R175H). R248Q has well-documented gain-of-function (GOF) activities in mouse models — accelerates tumorigenesis and metastasis beyond simple p53-null. Clinical implications mirror other TP53 hotspots: in AML/MDS routes away from intensive chemo toward venetoclax-azacitidine + alloSCT; in CLL/MCL/MM contraindicates chemoimmuno or routes to high-risk-cytogenetics regimens. Distinction from R248W (different substitution, also a hotspot) — R248Q tends to retain partial folding while R248W more disruptive; both are pathogenic.
R273 is among the top three most-mutated: R273 is among the top three most-mutated TP53 codons (with R175 and R248). DNA-contact class: R273 directly contacts the DNA major groove via its guanidinium side chain. R→H substitution preserves the thermal stability of the protein fold (distinguishing it from structural R175H) but eliminates specific DNA binding. R273H is one of the best-characterized GOF p53 mutants — promotes chemoresistance via NF-κB activation, drives invasion/metastasis through CXCR4 and RhoA pathways, reprograms metabolism (mevalonate pathway upregulation). Clinical implications mirror the TP53-mutant class: AML/MDS — venetoclax-azacitidine + alloSCT consideration; CLL/MCL — contraindicates chemoimmuno; MM — high-risk cytogenetics composite routes to quadruplet. Notably, R273H tumors are particularly resistant to platinum chemotherapy across solid-tumor types per multiple correlative analyses — relevant for ovarian, lung, esophageal cancer treatment selection.
R282 is the sixth most-mutated TP53 codo: R282 is the sixth most-mutated TP53 codon, often grouped with R248 and R273 as the canonical hotspot ring. Hybrid structural/contact mutant: R282 stabilizes the L1/S3 loop region adjacent to the DNA-binding surface, and R→W partially destabilizes the fold while altering contact geometry. Functional studies show R282W retains partial transactivation activity on a subset of canonical p53 targets (CDKN1A/p21, BBC3/PUMA at reduced levels) — termed "partial LoF" — while still gaining oncogenic activities. Clinically R282W behaves similarly to other hotspots: in AML/MDS poor chemo response → routes to venetoclax-azacitidine + alloSCT consideration; in CLL/MCL/MM high-risk regimen routing. Distinction from full LoF mutants (truncating, splice-site) may matter for emerging mutant-p53 reactivator drugs (eprenetapopt) where residual fold is required — R282W generally considered reactivatable in early-phase trials.

RB1 alterations (deletion, mutation) occur in ~30% of muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) and are enriched in the basal/squamous-differentiated molecular subtype (~50%). RB1 loss is associated with resistance to CDK4/6 inhibitors (which require pRb to exert G1 arrest). In urothelial cancer, CDK4/6 inhibitors are investigational (no approved indication); however, RB1 status is being evaluated as a predictive biomarker for CDK4/6 inhibitor non-response in HR+ cancers where bladder patients are enrolled in basket trials. Therapeutic implications in bladder cancer: (1) RB1 loss may associate with sensitivity to immunotherapy (higher genomic instability) — inconsistent evidence; (2) Basal/squamous subtype (often RB1-low) responds better to neoadjuvant chemotherapy than luminal subtypes; (3) No approved targeted therapy exploits RB1 deficiency in bladder cancer as of 2026. ESCAT IIIB: RB1 is a prognostic and potential therapeutic vulnerability marker in urothelial cancer; no approved targeted agent.

RB1 biallelic loss, together with TP53 loss, is the molecular hallmark of SCLC (~95% of cases have both). RB1 loss is not used to select therapy in SCLC (all SCLC patients receive the same backbone: EP/EC ± atezolizumab/durvalumab); rather, it is a diagnostic characteristic and potential therapeutic vulnerability. RB1 loss renders cells dependent on alternative cell cycle regulators (CDK4/6-independent E2F activation) — this is why CDK4/6 inhibitors have no activity in SCLC (pRb loss negates CDK4/6 inhibition). Investigational targeting of RB1-deficient SCLC: aurora kinase A inhibitors (alisertib — phase II, limited activity); EZH2 inhibitors (tazemetostat — RB1-null tumors may have heightened EZH2 dependence); LSD1 inhibitors; ATR/CHK1 inhibitors (replication stress in RB1-null context). ESCAT IIIB: RB1 loss is diagnostically informative and a conceptual therapeutic target, but no FDA-approved targeted therapy exploiting RB1 deficiency as of 2026.
RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma protein (: RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), the master G1/S checkpoint regulator. pRb normally sequesters E2F transcription factors to prevent S-phase entry; loss of pRb → uncontrolled cell cycle progression. Clinical contexts: (1) Hereditary retinoblastoma: germline RB1 mutation → bilateral/multifocal retinoblastoma in childhood; lifetime elevated risk of osteosarcoma, SCLC, melanoma. (2) SCLC: biallelic RB1 loss + TP53 mutation defines the SCLC molecular signature (~95% of SCLC). pRb loss by IHC is used in pathologic diagnosis. No targeted therapy for RB1 deficiency per se; SCLC treatment is chemotherapy (EP/EC) ± atezolizumab. (3) Urothelial carcinoma: RB1 alterations in ~30% of muscle-invasive bladder cancer; associated with basal/squamous subtype; not currently targeted. (4) Breast cancer: RB1 mutations occur in ~10% of TNBC; RB1 loss predicts resistance to CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib, ribociclib, abemaciclib) — pRb is the substrate for CDK4/6 that drives cell cycle entry; without pRb, CDK4/6 inhibition is ineffective. RB1 germline pathogenic variants cause heritable retinoblastoma (~40% of retinoblastoma cases) — bilateral / multifocal disease in 80% of carriers, median age at diagnosis ~12 months. Carriers face lifetime ~50% risk of secondary primary cancers (osteosarcoma, soft-tissue sarcoma, melanoma, lung, bladder); cumulative risk markedly elevated after external-beam radiation therapy (EBRT) — modern protocols avoid EBRT to mitigate. Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol (per COG / Children's Oncology Group + International Retinoblastoma Consortium): pediatric ophthalmology with EUA (examination under anesthesia) starting in newborn period — every 2-4 weeks until age 1, then progressive lengthening to monthly → q3mo → q6mo through age 7, annual through adolescence. Cascade testing to all first-degree relatives mandatory. Radiotherapy contraindicated or declined for early-stage NLPBL (nodular lymphocyte-predominant B-cell lymphoma, WHO 5th ed). Major clinical scenarios: (1) Young patient with breast or thyroid field overlap — cumulative RT dose risk of secondary malignancy and cardiac toxicity unacceptable; (2) Prior RT to the involved or adjacent region — reirradiation risks exceed benefit; (3) Patient refuses RT after informed discussion. In all scenarios rituximab monotherapy (4–8 × R weekly) achieves ~94% ORR with ≥70% CR in early-stage NLPBL (Advani 2014, IELSG-37 data) and is the accepted standard alternative. RT remains the default for eligible patients where field is safe and patient consents (stage IA-IIA, ≤2 cm).

MAIA control arm outcomes: ORR 75.8%, PFS HR (D-Rd vs Rd) 0.56 (95% CI 0.43–0.73), 30-month PFS ~53.3% for D-Rd vs ~37.8% for Rd. Rd continuous showed superiority over MPT and melphalan-prednisone in the FIRST trial (Benboubker NEJM 2014, PMID 25184863): PFS 26 months vs 21.9 months for MPT. Dose of dexamethasone: low-dose (40 mg weekly = "Ld schedule") is preferred over high-dose (480 mg/cycle); ECOG E4A03 showed equivalent efficacy and better tolerability with low-dose dex in NDMM (Rajkumar LANCET ONCOL 2010). Renal adjustment is critical: lenalidomide is ~80% renally cleared. CrCl 30-60 → 10 mg daily; CrCl <30 → 5 mg daily or 10 mg qod. Myeloma renal impairment often improves with therapy — recheck CrCl monthly and escalate dose when GFR recovers. Second primary malignancy (SPM) risk: CALGB 100104 and IFM 2005-02 documented elevated SPM (MDS/AML) with lenalidomide maintenance post-ASCT; risk applies to continuous Rd as well at smaller magnitude. Reproductive history combining late first full-term pregnancy (age ≥30) OR nulliparity, AND short cumulative lifetime breastfeeding duration (<6 months total). Both factors independently confer modest increases in hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer risk (RR ~1.2-1.4 each) per Collaborative Group on Hormonal Factors in Breast Cancer + WCRF/AICR. Breastfeeding is protective in dose- dependent fashion (~4% breast cancer risk reduction per 12 months of cumulative breastfeeding). Mechanism: cumulative ovulatory cycles + unopposed estrogen exposure + delayed terminal differentiation of breast ductal epithelium. Effect cumulative with other reproductive factors (early menarche, late menopause, nulliparity, HRT). Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 v0.3 reproductive pilot).

Reversible non-steroidal inhibitor of cy: Reversible non-steroidal inhibitor of cytochrome P450 aromatase (CYP19A1), reducing peripheral conversion of androgens to estrogens (estradiol, estrone). In postmenopausal women aromatase activity in adipose, breast, and other peripheral tissue is the dominant estrogen source — anastrozole 1 mg/day suppresses circulating estradiol by ~80-95%. Cancer-prevention rationale: estrogen exposure is the dominant driver of HR-positive breast carcinogenesis, and near-complete suppression of postmenopausal estrogen production reduces incidence of ER-positive breast cancer (and DCIS). IBIS-II RCT (Cuzick Lancet 2014, 12-year follow-up Lancet 2020): in 3,864 postmenopausal high-risk women, anastrozole 1 mg/day for 5 years reduced breast-cancer incidence by ~49% vs. placebo (HR 0.51) with durable benefit out to 12 years.
Reversible selective allosteric inhibito: Reversible selective allosteric inhibitor of MEK1 and MEK2, binding adjacent to the ATP site and preventing phosphorylation/activation of ERK1/2 in the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling cascade. Used in combination with vemurafenib (BRAFi) for BRAF V600 unresectable / metastatic melanoma to suppress paradoxical MAPK pathway reactivation seen with BRAFi monotherapy (coBRIM, mPFS 12.3 vs 7.2 mo for vemurafenib alone; mOS 22.3 vs 17.4 mo). Also part of the IMspire150 triplet (atezolizumab + cobimetinib + vemurafenib) for previously untreated BRAF V600 advanced melanoma, where the addition of atezolizumab modestly extended PFS. Off-label in NF1 plexiform neurofibroma and RAS-mutant histiocytic neoplasms.

Revumenib (SNDX-5613), an oral menin inhibitor, is FDA-approved (Nov 2024) for relapsed/refractory KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia (AML and ALL). AUGMENT-101 (Issa et al. NEJM 2023; Erba et al. ASH 2023 update): KMT2A-rearranged R/R AML/ALL — ORR 23% (CR + CRh + CRi), complete remission with full recovery 18%; mOS 8.0 mo. FDA accelerated approval based on remission rate as surrogate endpoint. KMT2A rearrangement is present in ~10% of adult AML (more common in secondary/therapy-related AML and infant leukemia). Menin is an essential co-factor of KMT2A-fusion oncoproteins — revumenib disrupts menin-MLL interaction, restoring differentiation block. Combination strategies under evaluation: revumenib + venetoclax + azacitidine (phase II ongoing). ELN 2022 risk: KMT2A-rearranged AML classified as intermediate risk (specific partner-dependent — MLLT3 intermediate; others may be adverse).

Revumenib (menin inhibitor) FDA-approved (Nov 2024) for relapsed/refractory KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia including B-ALL. AUGMENT-101 combined KMT2A-rearranged cohort (AML + ALL): ORR 23%, CR/CRh 18%. KMT2A rearrangement defines a high-risk B-ALL subset: in infants KMT2A-AFF1 is present in ~80% of infant B-ALL (EFS <30% with standard chemotherapy); in adults KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL is adverse-risk (NCCN/ELN). Revumenib represents a first targeted option for this historically chemotherapy-refractory population. Blinatumomab (CD19 BiTE, FDA-approved for R/R B-ALL) and inotuzumab ozogamicin are also active in KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL regardless of KMT2A status, but revumenib is the first mutation-specific approved agent. AlloHCT in CR remains the standard consolidation for eligible adults.

SMARCB1 (INI1/hSNF5/BAF47) is a core sub: SMARCB1 (INI1/hSNF5/BAF47) is a core subunit of the SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex. Biallelic inactivation removes SWI/SNF antagonism of EZH2 (PRC2 complex), leading to H3K27me3 accumulation and epigenetic silencing of tumor suppressor genes. This makes SMARCB1-deficient tumors selectively sensitive to EZH2 inhibition. SMARCB1 loss defines three main tumor types: (1) Epithelioid sarcoma — tazemetostat FDA-approved (2020; EZH-202 trial). (2) Malignant rhabdoid tumor (MRT, AT/RT in CNS) — extremely aggressive; no approved targeted therapy; investigational EZH2 inhibitors. (3) SMARCB1-deficient chordoma, sinonasal carcinoma — rare. IHC for INI1 (nuclear loss) is the companion diagnostic for tazemetostat in epithelioid sarcoma and is simpler than molecular testing. Note: retained INI1 expression does NOT exclude epithelioid sarcoma — ~10% of cases have normal INI1 by IHC despite molecular loss (technical or heterogeneous loss).

SMO (Smoothened) is a G-protein-coupled: SMO (Smoothened) is a G-protein-coupled receptor that transmits Hedgehog (HH) signaling. Normally suppressed by PTCH1; activated when PTCH1 loses its inhibitory function (whether via PTCH1 loss-of-function or SMO gain-of-function mutation). SMO activating mutations (~10–20% of BCCs) and PTCH1 loss-of-function (~90% of BCCs) both result in constitutive HH pathway activation. Vismodegib and sonidegib are SMO antagonists — they bind the SMO transmembrane domain and block downstream HH signaling (GLI1/2 repression). In practice, BCC HHI therapy does not require pre-testing for SMO vs PTCH1 mutation — all BCCs have HH pathway activation. SMO mutations also occur in sporadic medulloblastoma (SHH subtype) and rarely in other tumors. Resistance: secondary SMO mutations (D473H most common) emerge during vismodegib therapy, driving acquired resistance. Sonidegib may be active in some vismodegib-resistant D473H mutants.

SUFU germline pathogenic variants cause a Gorlin-syndrome–like predisposition with much higher medulloblastoma risk than PTCH1 (~30% lifetime vs ~5% in PTCH1), and lower BCC burden. SUFU-driven medulloblastomas cluster in the SHH-activated molecular subgroup (infant/young-child onset, desmoplastic / MBEN histology in many cases). Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol (per Foulkes et al. 2017 / AACR Pediatric Predisposition Working Group): brain MRI q4mo from diagnosis through age 3, q6mo from age 3-5, annually to age 8 — denser-than-PTCH1 cadence reflects higher MB risk. Dermatology surveillance for BCC q6-12mo from puberty. Avoid craniospinal external-beam radiation when alternatives exist (second-malignancy risk in carriers). Hedgehog-pathway inhibitors (vismodegib, sonidegib) have limited activity in SUFU-mutant SHH-MB — downstream-of-SMO position renders SMO inhibitors ineffective; this is a critical distinction from PTCH1-driven disease. ESCAT IIA.
SUFU germline — drives Gorlin-syndrome v: SUFU germline — drives Gorlin-syndrome variant with markedly higher pediatric medulloblastoma risk (~33%, SHH-subtype, often <3 years) compared with PTCH1-Gorlin (~5%). Lower BCC burden than PTCH1. Other features overlap NBCCS (jaw keratocysts may be less prevalent). AVOID craniospinal radiation when feasible — drives second primaries / treatment-related BCCs. Surveillance: brain MRI every 3-4 months in infants/young children. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff.
SUNLIGHT trial (Prager 2023): 3L+ mCRC a: SUNLIGHT trial (Prager 2023): 3L+ mCRC after standard chemo — TAS-102 + bevacizumab vs TAS-102 alone improved mOS 10.8 vs 7.5 mo (HR 0.61), PFS 5.6 vs 2.4 mo (HR 0.44), ORR 6.3% vs 1.0%. PSA can be falsely elevated in BPH, prostatitis, urinary retention, recent instrumentation. Free PSA ratio, PSA density, and reflex biomarkers (PHI, 4Kscore, SelectMDx) reduce unnecessary biopsy. Limitations: overdiagnosis/overtreatment of indolent cancers (well-characterized harm — driver of USPSTF Grade C). STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff.

Second most common IDH1 variant. Distrib: Second most common IDH1 variant. Distribution differs by disease: R132C is the dominant IDH1 variant in cholangiocarcinoma (~25-30% of IDH1-mutant CCA per ClarIDHy) and chondrosarcoma; in glioma it is rarer than R132H (<5%); in AML R132C accounts for ~30% of IDH1 mutations. Critically, R132C is IHC-NEGATIVE with the R132H-specific antibody (clone H09) — relying on IHC alone misses these patients. Ivosidenib (Tibsovo) is approved for IDH1-mutant cholangiocarcinoma (ClarIDHy 2L+) and IDH1-mutant AML (AGILE in combination with azacitidine 1L unfit; monotherapy R/R) — labels cover all IDH1 variants on the proven hotspot list (R132C/R132G/R132H/R132L/R132S), not just R132H. Reuses existing REG-IVOSIDENIB and IDH1-keyed indications via this biomarker entity.
Second of three Ashkenazi Jewish founder: For det andet af tre Ashkenazi jødiske grundlægger mutationer. Single-nukleotid dupleks (cytosin) i exon 20 forårsager rammeskift og for tidlig terminering — trunkerer BRCA1 inden for BRCT2-domænet, afskaffe C-terminal proteinbindende funktion afgørende for samordning af homologe-rekombinations reparationer. Også kaldet 5382insC i gammel nomenklatur (forfald ved stop-codon counting convention skift). Recurrent grundlægger effekt i AJ populationer (~0.8-1,0% bærefrekvens i Aj vs <0.1% non-AJ); også rapporteret som en tilbagevendende variant i polsk, russisk, hvid-hviderussisk population (sannsynligt separat grundlægger begivenheder eller AJ admiksed). Livstidskræft risici i overensstemmelse med BRCA1 gennemsnit. NCCN 2025 støtter populationsdækkende AJ grundlæggerpanel test (3-mutation panel) uanset familiehistorie. Samme overvågning og risikoreduktion protokoller som andre BRCA1-patogene varianter. STUB venter på to-Co-Lead afslag.
Second-generation HIV-1 integrase strand: Second-generation HIV-1 integrase strand-transfer inhibitor (INSTI) formulated as a long-acting injectable nanosuspension. Blocks integration of viral DNA into the host chromosome — same INSTI mechanism as dolutegravir and bictegravir, with similar high barrier to resistance. Sustained-release IM depot provides therapeutic plasma cabotegravir for ~2-3 months per dose. As HIV-1 PRE-EXPOSURE PROPHYLAXIS in HIV-negative adults at substantial risk, CAB-LA reduces sexual HIV acquisition by ~69% vs daily oral FTC/TDF in HPTN 083 (cisgender MSM / transgender women) and by ~89% in HPTN 084 (cisgender women at risk in sub-Saharan Africa) — superior efficacy to oral PrEP, driven by improved adherence over daily pills. Second-generation phosphonamidate prodru: Second-generation phosphonamidate prodrug of tenofovir; stabilized to resist plasma hydrolysis (versus TDF) so it preferentially delivers tenofovir intracellularly to hepatocytes (HBV) and lymphocytes (HIV). Once in target cell, intracellular cathepsin A cleaves TAF to tenofovir, which is then phosphorylated to tenofovir-DP and competitively inhibits HBV polymerase / HIV-1 reverse transcriptase with chain termination. Yields ~90% lower systemic tenofovir exposure than TDF at equivalent intracellular concentrations — reduced renal and bone toxicity.

Secondary-amine tricyclic antidepressant: Secondary-amine tricyclic antidepressant; primary action is inhibition of norepinephrine reuptake (modest serotonin reuptake inhibition), with antagonism at histamine H1, muscarinic, and α1-adrenergic receptors. Mechanism in tobacco cessation is not fully established — proposed contributions include noradrenergic modulation of nicotine withdrawal, anxiety/depressive-symptom mitigation during quit attempts, and direct effect on smoking-related dopaminergic circuits. Cochrane meta-analysis (Hughes 2014 update) — nortriptyline approximately doubles long-term cessation rates vs placebo (RR ~2.0), comparable to bupropion and NRT; LESS evidence and LOWER tolerability than varenicline (DRUG-VARENICLINE — first-line per USPSTF 2021). OFF-LABEL use; second / third-line option for cessation when varenicline / bupropion / NRT have failed or are contraindicated.

Selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist; blo: Selektiv 5- HT3- receptorantagonist; blokerer vagal stimulering af opkastningsrefleks.
Selective ATP-competitive BRAF V600E/K k: Selektiv ATP-konkurrencedygtig BRAF V600E/Kkinase hæmmer. Længere målopholdstid end vemurafenib/dabrafenib → mindre paradoksalt ERK-aktivering i WT BRAF-celler. I mCRC BRAF W600E + cetuximab (BEACON CRC) — første BRAF - målrettet godkendelse i CRC.
Selective ATP-competitive small-molecule: Selective ATP-competitive small-molecule TKI of VEGFR-1, VEGFR-2, and VEGFR-3 with sub-nanomolar in-vitro potency and improved selectivity over first-generation multikinase TKIs (sunitinib, sorafenib). Blocks VEGF-driven endothelial proliferation, migration, and survival in the tumor microenvironment, producing predominantly anti-angiogenic effects with minimal direct cytotoxicity. Short half-life (~2.5-6 h) gives titratable BID dosing — characteristic patient-specific dose escalation based on blood-pressure response (titrate up to 10 mg BID if BP tolerable at 5 mg). Pivotal evidence: AXIS (axitinib vs sorafenib 2L mRCC post-sunitinib/cytokines: mPFS 6.7 vs 4.7 mo); KEYNOTE-426 (pembrolizumab + axitinib vs sunitinib 1L mRCC: mPFS 15.7 vs 11.1 mo, OS HR 0.53), JAVELIN Renal 101 (avelumab + axitinib vs sunitinib 1L mRCC).
Selective BRAF V600E/K inhibitor. Always: Selective BRAF V600E/K inhibitor. Always combined with trametinib (MEKi) to prevent paradoxical RAF activation in BRAF-WT cells and improve efficacy.
Selective Coverage Versus Comprehensive: Selektiv dækning Versus omfattende dækning Radioterapi i dårligt differentieret og anaplastisk skjoldbruskkirtelkræft
Selective IDH1 inhibitor for R/R IDH1-mu: Selective IDH1 inhibitor for R/R IDH1-mutant AML in adults. Pivotal Study 2102-HEM-101 (single-arm, n=153, R/R IDH1-mut AML, olutasidenib 150 mg PO BID) — CR + CRh 35%; mDOR 25.9 mo (CR/CRh subgroup); transfusion independence 56-month; ~30% transitioned to allo-HSCT. Compares favorably to ivosidenib (alternative IDH1 inhibitor — separate regimen entity, future). BOXED WARNINGS: differentiation syndrome (~16%) + hepatotoxicity (~21% Grade ≥3 transaminitis). Used as bridge to allo-HSCT in fit patients. Ivosidenib + azacitidine combination (AGILE trial, newly-diagnosed unfit IDH1-mut AML) is a separate regimen entity. STUB — pending Study 2102-HEM-101 trial Source ingestion (SRC-OLUTASIDENIB-DEBOTTON-2023) and Co-Lead sign-off.
Selective JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor. Blocks JA: Selektiv JAK1/JAK2-hæmmer. Blokerer JAK-STAT-signaler drevet af JAK2 V617F (og CALR/MPL via JAK2-dimerisering). Reducerer splenomegali + symptomer i MF/PV/ET; eliminerer ikke klon. Ryggben af MF symptomdrevet terapi.
Selective JAK2 inhibitor for MF post-rux: Selektiv JAK2 hæmmer for MF post-ruxolitinib fejl eller intolerans. JAKARTA-2 fase-2 + FREEDOM-2 fase-3 bekræftelse. Wernecke encefalopati bokset advarsel - obligatorisk thiamin måling + supplement. Tag med mad. STUB — afventende Co-Lead afmærkning.
Selective JAK2 inhibitor with FLT3 activ: Selektiv JAK2- hæmmer med FLT3- aktivitet. Aktiv i MF efter ruxolitinib svigt / intolerans. Bøsset advarsel for Wernicke- encefalopati (tiaminmangel).
Selective KIT and PDGFRA inhibitor desig: Selective KIT and PDGFRA inhibitor designed to bind the active conformation; uniquely active against the imatinib-resistant KIT D816V (advanced systemic mastocytosis) and PDGFRA D842V (GIST) activation-loop mutations. NAVIGATOR (PDGFRA D842V GIST) ORR ~88%; EXPLORER + PATHFINDER (advanced SM) ORR ~75% with deep molecular responses.
Selective MEK inhibitor used in combinat: Selective MEK inhibitor used in combination with dabrafenib. Reduces resistance + skin toxicity vs BRAFi alone.
Selective MET inhibitor with similar eff: Selective MET inhibitor with similar efficacy profile to capmatinib. VISION trial: ORR ~46% in 1L MET ex14+ NSCLC.
Selective RNA polymerase II inhibitor (a: Selektiv RNA polymerase II- hæmmer (alkylerende- lignende trabectedin analog)
Selective TKI of BCR-ABL1 (~30× more pot: Selective TKI of BCR-ABL1 (~30× more potent than imatinib). Active against most imatinib-resistant mutations except T315I, V299L, F317L. Vascular adverse-event profile (PAOD, MI, stroke) is the dose-limiting concern long-term.
Selective TKI of BCR-ABL1, KIT, PDGFR-α/: Selektiv TKI af BCR- ABL1, KIT, PDGFR- α/ β. Grundlægger af den målrettede CML- æra. Standard CML 1L til lavrisikopatienter, patienter med komorbiditet eller patienter med omkostningsrelateret instruering.
Selective allosteric (non-ATP-competitiv: Selective allosteric (non-ATP-competitive) inhibitor of MEK1/MEK2 kinases that bind a pocket adjacent to the ATP site, locking MEK in an inactive conformation. Blocks downstream phosphorylation of ERK1/2 in the constitutively activated RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK pathway, suppressing proliferation and survival signaling in BRAF V600-mutant tumor cells. Combined with a BRAF inhibitor (encorafenib) the doublet mitigates paradoxical MAPK reactivation seen with BRAFi monotherapy and prolongs response duration. Clinical evidence: COLUMBUS (encorafenib + binimetinib vs vemurafenib in BRAF V600 unresectable / metastatic melanoma, mPFS 14.9 vs 7.3 mo, mOS 33.6 vs 16.9 mo). Historically evaluated as the third agent in BEACON-CRC triplet (no OS gain over encorafenib + cetuximab doublet — doublet is the standard for BRAF V600E mCRC).
Selective alpha-1 blockade gives less re: Selektiv alfa-1 blokade giver mindre reflekstakykardi og lettere generel tilgængelighed end phenoxybenzamin (DRUG-PHENOXYBENZAMINE), hvilket gør doxazosin til et almindeligt anvendt praktisk alternativ til obligatorisk præoperativ PPGL alfa-blokkade; valg mellem de to er pr. lokal praksis/tilgængelighed, ikke modelleret som en KB-niveau præference. STUB afventer kliniske co-lead-afmærkning (CHARTER §6.1, dev-mode-ekskrementeret).
Selective competitive antagonist at the: Selective competitive antagonist at the 5-hydroxytryptamine type 3 (5-HT3) serotonin receptor located peripherally on vagal afferent terminals in the GI tract and centrally in the chemoreceptor trigger zone (area postrema). Distinguishing features vs first-generation 5-HT3 antagonists (ondansetron, granisetron): ~30× higher receptor binding affinity, ~7× longer plasma half-life (~40 h vs ~4-6 h), and demonstrated allosteric receptor cross-talk with NK1 receptors that contributes to superior delayed-phase CINV control. A single IV or oral dose covers both acute (0-24 h) and delayed (24-120 h) phases of CINV. Approved by FDA July 2003 and EMA March 2005.

Selective competitive antagonist at the histamine H2 receptor on gastric parietal cells, blocking histamine-stimulated gastric acid secretion (basal, nocturnal, food-stimulated, and pentagastrin- stimulated) — produces ~50-90% acid suppression depending on dose. In allergic reactions and chemotherapy infusion reactions, the H2 antagonism complements H1 antagonist (diphenhydramine) blockade — histamine acts on both H1 (bronchospasm, vasodilation, urticaria, pruritus) AND H2 (vasodilation, gastric secretion, cardiac inotropy) receptors, and combined H1 + H2 blockade is superior to either alone for prevention and treatment of urticaria, mild anaphylactoid reactions, and chemotherapy infusion reactions (paclitaxel, carboplatin retreatment, monoclonal antibodies). Selective competitive antagonist of the: Selektiv konkurrencehæmmende antagonist af stoffet P/ NK1- receptoren i CNS- emetiske centre (nukleus tuctus solitarius, områdepostrema), blokerelse af den sene fase af kemoterapiinduceret kvalme og opkastning (CINV) medieret af stof P. Desituishing farmakokinetiske træk er en usædvanlig lang terminal halveringstid på ~7 dage (~169 timer), som giver receptordækning på tværs af den fulde 5- dage forsinkede fase fra en enkelt oral dosis uden behov for opfølgningsdoser på dag 2- 3. Godkendt af FDA september 2015 og EMA april 2017 til forebyggelse af forsinket CINV hos voksne, der modtager HEC eller MEC.
Selective high-affinity antagonist of th: Selective high-affinity antagonist of the human substance P / neurokinin-1 (NK1) receptor in the central nervous system, blocking the late vomiting signal mediated by substance P binding in the nucleus tractus solitarius and area postrema. This complements the early-phase blockade by 5-HT3 antagonists (which control acute CINV) by preventing the delayed phase (24-120 h post-chemotherapy). Standard component of triple-antiemetic prophylaxis (NK1 + 5-HT3 + dexamethasone, ± olanzapine) for highly emetogenic chemotherapy (HEC) such as cisplatin ≥50 mg/m², AC (anthracycline + cyclophosphamide), and BEACOPP. Approved by FDA March 2003 and EMA November 2003.
Selective inhibitor of MET (c-MET) tyros: Selektiv hæmmer af MET (c-MET) tyrosinkinase. GEOMETRI mono-1: ORR ~68% i 1L MET ex14-mutant NSCLC.
Selective inhibitor of PI3K-alpha (p110α: Selective inhibitor of PI3K-alpha (p110α isoform). Active in PIK3CA-mutant HR+/HER2- metastatic — combined with fulvestrant per SOLAR-1.
Selective inhibitor of cyclin-dependent: Selektiv hæmmer af cyklinafhængige kinaser 4 og 6 — blokerer Rb fosforylering, anholdelse af celler i G1. Kombineret med endokrine behandlinger i HR+/HER2- metastaserende; moderat adjuvant fordel (PALLAS / PENELOPE-B negativ).
Selective inhibitor of cyclooxygenase-2: Selektiv hæmmer af cycloxygenase-2 (COX-2; ~10-20-fold selektivitet over COX-1 ved terapeutiske koncentrationer), undertrykkende prostaglandin-drevet inflammation, proliferation og angiogenese med relativt skånet trombocyt COX- 1 (ingen antitrombocyt effekt ved standarddoser) og reduceret gastrisk mucosal COX-1- (mindre gastrointestinale blødninger end ikke-selektive NSAIDs). Cancer-forebyggende begrundelse: COX-2 er opreguleret i adenomer og mange tumorer; hæmning reducerer PGE2-drevet proliferition og immunudslippe. I FAP reducerede celecoxib duodenal polyp- byrden (Steinbach NEJM 2000) — tidligere FDA- godkendt til FAP- relateret polypose (orfan betegnelse), tilbagekaldt 2011 af sponsor efter undersøgelser efter markedsføring bekræftede ikke fordelen.
Selective irreversible CYP17A1 inhibitor: Selektiv irreversibel CYP17A1- hæmmer — blokerer binyre - og intratumoral androgensyntese (testosteron, DHT- prækursorer) altid kombineret med lavdosis kortikosteroid (prednison) for at reducere mineralokortikoidoverskud (hypertension, hypokalæmi, væskeretention).
Selective irreversible inhibitor of the: Selective irreversible inhibitor of the chymotrypsin-like activity of the 20S proteasome (β5 / LMP7 subunits). Binds covalently via epoxyketone — distinct from bortezomib's reversible boronate binding — conferring sustained inhibition + activity in bortezomib-refractory myeloma. Single doses can suppress proteasome activity >80% for >24h.
Selective oral inhibitor of CSF1R (colon: Selective oral inhibitor of CSF1R (colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor), KIT, and FLT3. In TGCT (formerly PVNS), tumor cells overexpress CSF1 (via COL6A3-CSF1 translocation), driving recruitment of CSF1R-expressing macrophages and osteoclast-like giant cells that constitute the bulk of the tumor mass. Pexidartinib depletes these CSF1R+ cells, reducing tumor burden. ILLUMINATE trial: ORR 38% (vs 0% placebo), with 15% complete response. FDA-approved August 2019 — first systemic therapy for TGCT.
Selective oral inhibitor of EZH2 (Enhanc: Selektiv oral hæmmer af EZH2 (Forbedrer af Zeste Homolog 2) — den katalytiske subenhed af Kina2 (Polycomb Repressive Complex 2). Blokker H3K27 trimethylering, derepressing tumor-suppressor gener. Effektiv mod både EZ H2 wild-type (epimetisk afhængighed) og Y641 forstærkning muteret FL — overlegen respons i muterede subgrupper.
Selective partial agonist at the α4β2 ni: Selective partial agonist at the α4β2 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor — the principal mediator of nicotine-induced dopaminergic reward. Partial agonism produces modest dopamine release (relieving craving and withdrawal) while simultaneously blocking nicotine binding (reducing reinforcement from any cigarettes smoked during titration). Most effective monotherapy for tobacco cessation (USPSTF / AHCPR).
Selective short-acting β2-adrenergic ago: Selective short-acting β2-adrenergic agonist that activates β2 receptors on bronchial smooth muscle, stimulating adenylyl cyclase → increased intracellular cAMP → relaxation of bronchial smooth muscle and bronchodilation. Onset of action 5-15 min after inhalation, peak effect 30-60 min, duration 4-6 h. Also produces mast cell membrane stabilization (modestly reducing histamine release), enhanced mucociliary clearance, and decreased microvascular permeability. Selectivity for β2 over β1 (~30:1) limits cardiac stimulation at therapeutic doses but loses selectivity at high doses or with parenteral routes (tachycardia, palpitations, modest blood pressure changes). In oncology supportive care, used for: (1) bronchospasm component of chemotherapy infusion reactions and anaphylaxis (adjunct to epinephrine, NOT substitute); (2) acute exacerbations of underlying asthma / COPD precipitated by inf...
Selective small-molecule inhibitor of hy: Selektiv lille-molecule hæmmer af hypoxia-inducible faktor 2α (HIF-2α). VHL inaktivering (som er aromatisk i ~90% af klar-celle RCC, germline i von Hippel-Lindau syndrom) → HIF-2ástabilisering → driver angiogenetisk / glykolytisk ccRCC phenotype. Belzutifan forstyrrer HIF-2α heterodimerisering med HIF-1β, undertrykkende nedstrøms transkriptionsprogram.
Selective, high-affinity D2-dopamine rec: Selective, high-affinity D2-dopamine receptor agonist with a long elimination half-life (~65 hours) permitting once- or twice-weekly oral dosing. Activates D2 receptors on pituitary lactotroph cells, suppressing prolactin synthesis/secretion and inducing lactotroph adenoma shrinkage in the majority of prolactinomas. First-line therapy for prolactinoma; superior prolactin-normalization rate, tumor-shrinkage rate, and tolerability compared with bromocriptine (older, less selective dopamine agonist).
Selectively and reversibly blocks post-s: Selectively and reversibly blocks post-synaptic alpha-1 adrenergic receptors, reducing catecholamine-mediated peripheral vasoconstriction with less reflex tachycardia than non-selective irreversible agents (phenoxybenzamine) because alpha-2 presynaptic auto-inhibition of norepinephrine release is preserved. Used as an alternative preoperative alpha-blocker in pheochromocytoma / paraganglioma (PPGL) where mandatory preoperative alpha-blockade is required before surgery to prevent intraoperative hypertensive crisis (Endocrine Society 2014 PPGL guideline).
Selectively binds BCL-2, displaces pro-a: Selektivt binder BCL-2, forskyder pro-apoptotic BH3-proteiner, genopretter apoptose i BCL-2-afhængige cancerceller. Meget aktiv i CLL (hvor CLl er BCL 2-addicted), AML, multipelt myelom. Væsentlig tumoranalyserisiko ved initiering - streng 5-ugers dosis ramp + TLS profylax påkrævet.
Selectively binds and activates retinoid: Selektivt binder og aktiverer retinoid X-receptorer (RXRα, RXRβ, R XRγ), som heterodimerer med andre atomreceptorer for at regulere genudtryk involveret i cellulær differentiering og proliferation. I CTCL inducerer apoptose og differensiering af maligne T- celler.
Selectively phosphorylated by viral thym: Selectively phosphorylated by viral thymidine kinase to acyclovir monophosphate, then by host kinases to acyclovir triphosphate, which inhibits viral DNA polymerase and terminates viral DNA chain elongation. Active against HSV-1, HSV-2, VZV; modest activity against EBV, CMV.
Selectively reduces platelet count by in: Sænker selektivt trombocyttallet ved at forstyrre megakaryoocytdifferentieringen. Sænks ikke WBC eller Hct (ulig HU). Anvendes som 2L cytoreduktion i ET, når HU intoleranseres eller er utilstrækkelig.

Semi-synthetic aminopenicillin that bind: Semi-synthetic aminopenicillin that binds to penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs) in actively dividing bacteria, inhibiting cross-linking of the peptidoglycan cell-wall layer and triggering autolysin-mediated bactericidal effect. Spectrum: broader than penicillin V/G — includes many Streptococcus spp., Enterococcus faecalis, Listeria monocytogenes, Helicobacter pylori, and some Gram-negatives (E. coli, Proteus mirabilis, Haemophilus influenzae, Salmonella, Shigella) where no β-lactamase expression. Susceptible to β-lactamase hydrolysis (hence Augmentin combination with clavulanic acid for many Gram-negative infections).
Semi-synthetic podophyllotoxin derivativ: Semi-synthetic podophyllotoxin derivative; stabilizes the cleavable topoisomerase II–DNA complex, preventing strand religation and producing protein-linked DNA double-strand breaks that trigger apoptosis. Cell-cycle S/G2 phase active. Semi-synthetic taxane derived from Europ: Halvsyntetisk taxan afledt af europæiske yew (Taxus baccata). Serum AFP is used in combination with ultrasound every 6 months for HCC surveillance in cirrhotic patients of any aetiology (Child-Pugh A/B7, candidates for treatment) and in non-cirrhotic chronic HBV with elevated HCC risk per AASLD HCC 2023. US-alone sensitivity is suboptimal (~63%); US + AFP raises sensitivity for early-stage HCC to ~70-80% with acceptable specificity (~85-90%). AFP threshold typically >20 ng/mL (some guidelines >7 ng/mL with risk-stratified cutoffs). Rising AFP trajectory is more informative than single value. AFP elevation also occurs in chronic hepatitis flares, regenerative nodules, germ-cell tumours, and gestation — interpret in context. Diagnostic workup of rising AFP: multiphasic CT or MRI per LI-RADS criteria. AFP-L3 fraction and DCP (PIVKA-II) are adjunct markers in some practices. ESCAT IIIA — AFP directs HCC diagnostic workup / surveillance cadence.

Serum calcitonin is a highly specific biomarker for medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) — produced by parafollicular C-cells. In MEN2 RET germline carriers, calcitonin trends inform timing of prophylactic thyroidectomy (RET codon-stratified per ATA Thyroid 2015 + Endocrine Society MEN 2023): - MEN2B (M918T): prophylactic thyroidectomy <1 year, before calcitonin rise becomes detectable - MEN2A high-risk codons (634, 883): thyroidectomy by age 5 - MEN2A moderate-risk codons (609, 611, 618, 620, 630, 631): may delay until calcitonin becomes detectable on stimulation testing Basal + stimulated (pentagastrin / calcium-stimulated where available) calcitonin tracks residual disease post-thyroidectomy. CEA is a complementary marker. Doubling time of calcitonin post-resection is a strong prognostic indicator (<6 mo = aggressive). ESCAT IIIA — calcitonin directs prophylactic surgery timing and post-operative monitoring.

Smoldering: ≥5% circulating abnormal lymphocytes, no organ involvement (skin/lung lesion permitted), LDH normal, BUN normal, albumin normal, no hypercalcemia, no lymphadenopathy or organomegaly. Sirolimus (rapamycin), an mTORC1 inhibitor, is FDA-approved (May 2015) and EMA-approved (2017) for treatment of LAM in adults. MILES phase III RCT (McCormack et al., NEJM 2011): N=89 (46 sirolimus, 43 placebo); 12-month treatment + 12-month observation. Primary endpoint: FEV1 change from baseline to 12 months (mL/month rate). FEV1 slope: +1 mL/month (sirolimus) vs -12 mL/month (placebo); difference 11 mL/month (p<0.001). Secondary: FVC improvement, VEGF-D reduction, 6-min walk improvement, QoL. After 12-month observation: benefits partially lost (FEV1 decline resumes), suggesting need for continuous therapy. mTOR inhibition does not eliminate LAM cells but controls their mTORC1-driven proliferation. Everolimus is used for TSC-associated LAM and for renal angiomyolipoma (EXIST-2). VEGF-D ≥800 pg/mL is a diagnostic biomarker (non-invasive diagnosis of LAM possible in right clinical context without biopsy).

Afbryder menin -MLL forskyder det leukemogene transcriptional program, indbringe differentiering og apoptose af leukemisk bluster. FDA-godkendt Nov 2024 på grundlag af AUGMENT-101 fase 1/2 fase forsøg.

Sokal score (Sokal 1984) uses age, splee: Sokal score (Sokal 1984) uses age, spleen size, platelet count, blast %. High-risk (Sokal >1.2) marks ~20-25% of CML-CP at diagnosis with worse 10-yr OS and PFS on imatinib vs intermediate/low. ENESTnd (Saglio 2010) and DASISION (Kantarjian 2010) show 2nd-gen TKIs achieve faster + deeper molecular responses than imatinib in high-Sokal subgroups. ELN 2020 prefers ELTS (RF-CML-HIGH-RISK-ELTS, existing) but Sokal remains the more widely-used bedside score. Companion to RF-HASFORD-HIGH; both can fire together. Conflict- resolution: this RF intensifies toward 2nd-gen TKI; cardiotoxicity flags (RF-CML-COMORBIDITY-COMPLEX) may de-escalate back to imatinib.

Solid-organ transplant recipient on chronic immunosuppression ≥3 years post-transplant, beyond the high-acute-rejection window — the chronic- cohort persona. Chronic-cohort risk profile shifts toward: cumulative skin-cancer burden (squamous-cell carcinoma 65-100x background; basal-cell carcinoma 10-20x; aggressive SCC subset prone to local recurrence + metastasis), late-onset post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD; late-onset PTLD ≥1y post-transplant more often EBV-negative, more diffuse-large-B-cell-like histology, worse prognosis than early-onset EBV-driven PTLD), Kaposi sarcoma in HHV-8-exposed cohort, cervical intraepithelial neoplasia / cervical cance...

Somatic (tumor-only) BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variant identified on tumor NGS — pan-tumor PARPi-candidate signal. Disease applicability varies: ovarian (PAOLA-1, SOLO-1 — somatic BRCA pooled with germline in HRD-positive maintenance indication), mCRPC (PROfound cohort-A — olaparib mPFS 7.4 vs 3.6 mo, HR 0.34, somatic + germline pooled), pancreatic PDAC (POLO label is germline-only — somatic BRCA falls to off-label / NCCN "consider" tier), breast (OlympiAD / EMBRACA / OlympiA labels are germline-only — somatic BRCA breast remains investigational). Confirm somatic vs germline status via paired germline NGS before cascade-testing decisions (~40% of tumor-only "BRCA" calls are in fact germline per ASCO/CAP guidance).

Standard 1L symptom-directed therapy for: Standard 1L symptom-directed therapy for symptomatic PMF (and post-PV/ET MF). Standard 2L mCRC after FOLFOX progressio: Standard 2L mCRC after FOLFOX progression. Standard H2 component of chemotherapy pr: Standard H2 component of chemotherapy premedication, paired with H1 antihistamine (diphenhydramine) and corticosteroid (dexamethasone). Particularly important before paclitaxel (Cremophor vehicle hyper- sensitivity), rituximab, daratumumab, and other monoclonal antibodies with significant infusion reaction rates. Combined H1 + H2 blockade is empirically superior to H1 alone for prevention of mild-to-moderate hypersensitivity reactions (Lieberman-Goodyear, 2010). NEVER a substitute for epinephrine in true anaphylaxis — H1 + H2 + steroid treats pruritus, urticaria, mild bronchospasm, but does not reverse hypotension or upper airway edema. Famotidine preferred over cimetidine in oncology because of clean DDI profile (cimetidine inhibits multiple CYPs causing exposure increases of warfarin, theophylline, phenytoin, TKIs, vincristine — major hazard); ranitidine withdrawn worldwide 2019-2020 for NDMA contamination. CRITICAL: H2 antagonists raise gastric pH → reduce absorption of pH-dependent oral oncology agents (dasatinib, erlotinib, gefitinib, dabigatran, atazanavir) — separate by 2-10 h or substitute / time TKI dose. Standard adjunct for bronchospasm compon: Standard adjunct for bronchospasm component of anaphylaxis, chemotherapy infusion reactions, and CAR-T cytokine release syndrome — given concurrently with epinephrine (epinephrine remains the FIRST-LINE for true anaphylaxis with hypotension or upper airway edema). Nebulized 2.5-5 mg q20min × 3 then q1-4h is standard for moderate-severe bronchospasm. Critical: salbutamol does NOT reverse hypotension or upper airway edema — if these are present, epinephrine IM thigh is mandatory and urgent. Add ipratropium 500 µg nebulized if bronchospasm refractory or severe (combined β2 + muscarinic blockade). For bronchospasm during paclitaxel, rituximab, or monoclonal antibody infusions: stop infusion, administer salbutamol nebulized, diphenhydramine + famotidine + steroid as supportive — escalate to epinephrine if hypotension / upper airway involvement / no response in 5-10 min. Avoid in patients with cardiomyopathy / serious arrhythmia (QT-prolonging chemotherapy regimens particularly — TKIs, arsenic trioxide). Tachycardia and hypokalemia are dose-related — monitor in continuous nebulization. Ukraine: cheap, ubiquitous, NSZU-covered.
Standard adjunct for chemotherapy infusi: Standard adjunct for chemotherapy infusion reactions and severe anaphylaxis — given AFTER epinephrine IM (epinephrine is first-line, no substitute). Hydrocortisone's onset is delayed (4-6 h) so it prevents biphasic anaphylaxis recurrence rather than treating the acute event. Premedication for chemotherapy (e.g., taxanes, rituximab, daratumumab): typically dexamethasone 20 mg IV is used rather than hydrocortisone — dex is more potent (×30) per mg, has longer duration, lacks mineralocorticoid effect (less fluid retention), and dosing schedule is established. Hydrocortisone preferred over dex / methylprednisolone for: (1) adrenal insufficiency / crisis (mineralocorticoid activity matches physiological need); (2) septic shock with vasopressor refractoriness (300 mg/day approximately physiologic stress dose); (3) acute high-dose adjunct for refractory infusion reaction where mineralocorticoid effect supports hemodynamics. Single bolus of 100-200 mg has minimal long-term consequences — no taper needed for ≤3 days of acute use. Ukraine: cheap, ubiquitous, NSZU- covered.

Standard antibacterial prophylaxis in hi: Standard antibacterial prophylaxis in high-risk febrile neutropenia per IDSA / NCCN: anticipated ANC <100/µL ≥7 days (HSCT conditioning, AML induction, high-dose chemo for relapsed leukemia/lymphoma). Boxed warning regarding hepatic tumors in rat carcinogenicity studies has not translated to human signal in two decades of post-marketing surveillance, but prescribing information warns against unnecessary prolonged use. Same spectrum limitations as caspofungin (no Mucor, no Cryptococcus, fungistatic for Aspergillus). Ukraine: registered, NSZU-covered; preferred echinocandin in HSCT contexts.

Standard first-line empirical antibiotic: Standard first-line empirical antibiotic for febrile neutropenia (FN) per IDSA 2010 (Freifeld), ECIL-4, and NCCN — combines pseudomonal coverage, broad anaerobic activity, and acceptable toxicity profile. Standard for stage III unresectable post: Standard for stage III unresectable post-concurrent CRT. Pneumonitis G≥2 at end of CRT excludes durva initiation.

Substituted benzamide that antagonizes d: Substituted benzamide that antagonizes dopamine D2 receptors centrally in the chemoreceptor trigger zone (area postrema) and peripherally in the upper GI tract, reducing nausea and accelerating gastric emptying. Also a 5-HT4 receptor agonist (potentiating release of acetylcholine in the enteric plexus → enhanced peristalsis) and at high doses (≥1 mg/kg) a weak 5-HT3 antagonist. The prokinetic action distinguishes it from pure D2 antagonists and is therapeutically useful for chemotherapy-induced gastroparesis, opioid-induced delayed gastric emptying, and post-treatment dyspepsia. Approved by FDA in 1979 for nausea/vomiting and gastroparesis; widely used as breakthrough antiemetic in CINV regimens. Use restricted in 2009 (FDA boxed warning) and 2013 (EMA) due to tardive dyskinesia risk with prolonged or high-dose use.

Cancer- prevention rationale: COX-2 is upregulated in FAP adenomas; sulindac reduces polyp number and size in FAP (Giardiello NEJM 1993 RCT — 150 mg BID for 9 months, ~56% reduction in polyp number, ~65% in size; pooled trials in retained rectum post-colectomy show similar effect). Dual agonism produces greater glycemic control and weight loss than GLP-1 monoagonism. At obesity dose (max 15 mg weekly), SURMOUNT-1 trial demonstrated ~21% mean weight loss vs ~3% on placebo — superior to semaglutide 2.4 mg.
